{{Quote|You&hellip; had discovered your lover&hellip; that pilot, Ash&hellip; with a Twi'lek dancing girl&hellip; and you ''snapped''&hellip;|A male Jedi while confronting Vydel Dir'Nul|<ref name="Dark Journey" />}}
This '''[[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]]''' made a living as a dancer during the final [[Time/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She became romantically involved with a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] named [[Ash B'risko]], who was in turn involved with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Vydel Dir'Nul]]. When Dir'Nul spotted the woman in B'risko's arms, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Death/Legends|murdered]] B'risko and then killed the Twi'lek.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Twi'lek female first appeared in the short [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] "[[Dark Journey (comic story)|Dark Journey]]," which was featured in [[Star Wars Tales 17|''Star Wars Tales'' 17]] and written by [[Jason Hall]]. The story was later compiled into a [[Star Wars comic books|trade paperback]] version and republished in ''[[Star Wars Tales Volume 5]]''.

Plausible stories in [[Star Wars Tales 1|''Star Wars Tales'' 1]]&ndash;''[[Star Wars Tales 20|20]]'' were deemed [[Canon|S-canon]] until referenced in a non-''Tales'' source, at which point the subject matter was elevated to C-canon status.<ref>{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=752#14952461|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2006-06-04|time=3:05 AM}}</ref> The character was mentioned in Vydel Dir'Nul's entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' {{C|Mentioned in ''Dir'Nul, Vydel''{{'s}} entry}}</ref> This elevated the character's appearance in ''Dark Journey'' to C-canon.
